text: Accnomos is built for UK businesses and the self-employed who get paid, and pay suppliers, through PayPal. Here's how it keeps the books.
Small businesses paid through PayPal still match the fees and the VAT by hand.
Monday. A receipt. Snap it, the AI reads it, code checks the VAT, and you approve.
The bank feed lands, and the matches are suggested. Bank, PayPal and everything else, reconciled in one place.
Time to get paid. Ask for an invoice in plain words, and add a PayPal pay link.
The customer pays. Press Sync PayPal, and in come the gross, PayPal's fee and the net. A sale with no invoice waits for your VAT choice, and nothing posts until you approve.
Then the tie-out checks your books against PayPal's own balance.
Busy week? The Power grid approves rows in bulk. Or filter in plain English: PayPal fees over £5.
say: Busy week? The Power grid approves rows in bulk. Or filter in plain English: PayPal fees over five pounds.

text: Bills go the other way. When one falls due, you approve it, and PayPal sends the payout. It posts only when PayPal confirms, and a retry never pays twice.
A customer disputes a payment? The evidence is built from your books, and you choose when to send it.
Can't remember something? Just ask. Did that client pay their arrears? Yes: £492, through PayPal. That stationery order, around £100? Exactly £97.79.
say: Can't remember something? Just ask. Did that client pay their arrears? Yes: four hundred and ninety-two pounds, through PayPal. That stationery order, around a hundred pounds? Exactly ninety-seven pounds, seventy-nine.

text: Hands full? Type it, or just say it.
Quarter end. The nine VAT boxes are worked out by code and filed to HMRC's sandbox, with HMRC's own receipt.
Plus HMRC-ready reports, from VAT to profit and loss.
And all of it is saved as plain files in your own drive.

So what makes Accnomos different? Your books live in your own OneDrive or Google Drive, not in our database. The AI proposes, code does the sums in pence, and you approve every posting. One search covers your books and PayPal. And the AI can run on your own machine.
And it's all one app: PayPal, books and tax, an assistant, and the rest of the business, on the web and on Android.
Built on five PayPal APIs, four of them run against PayPal's real sandbox, and about four thousand automated tests.
Everything you saw runs on PayPal's sandbox. Try it yourself at accnomos.com, no sign-in needed.
